### Issue URL (Ads) [https://chzzk.naver.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fchzzk.naver.com%2F) ### Comment > https://chzzk.naver.com/ 이 스트리밍 사이트에서 실시간 영상을 누르면 영상이 재생되지않고, 스크린샷과 같이 오른쪽 위에 광고표시가 뜨면서 백그라운드 소리만 들리면서 멈춘 상태와 비슷하게 됩니다. 광고 시간이 지나야 실시간 스트리밍 영상이 재생됩니다. 크롬, 웨일, 엣지 브라우저 모두 동일한 증상입니다. AdGuard 유료앱을 사용함에도 불구하고 광고가 나온 시기는 대략 3일 전입니다. 그 전에는 지금 설정 그대로 사용했어도 광고는 전혀 표시되지않았습니다. > > On the streaming website https://chzzk.naver.com/, when I click on a live stream, the video does not start playing. Instead, an ad indicator appears in the upper-right corner, as shown in the screenshot, while I can only hear the background audio. The video appears to be stuck or paused until the ad finishes, after which the live stream starts playing normally. > > I experience the same issue on Chrome, Whale, and Edge. > > I am using the paid version of AdGuard, but ads started appearing approximately three days ago. Before that, I had been using the exact same AdGuard settings, and no ads were shown at all. > ### Screenshots

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Ads) [https://www.qishui-china.com/windows](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.qishui-china.com%2Fwindows) ### Comment > ### Report: Newly Registered Phishing Domains (Silver Fox Trojan using MSI) > > **Hello AdGuard Team,** > > I found several phishing websites impersonating popular Chinese services (DeepSeek AI, Qishui Music, WhatsApp). These domains were all newly registered (mostly April to July 2026) using overseas registrars (such as Gname and GKG.Net). > > **Core Attack Vector:** The malicious payloads are disguised as **`.msi` (Windows Installer) files**. > When users extract the provided ZIP/RAR, they are presented with the malicious MSI. Because MSI is trusted by Windows, the **"Silver Fox" (银狐)** malware family utilizes these packages to bypass heuristic scanning. > > **Critical Attack Behavior:** > - **UAC Bypass:** Even if the user clicks "No" on the UAC (User Account Control) prompt, the malware **still runs**. > - **System Infection:** It hijacks and injects malicious DLLs into core system processes (such as `explorer.exe`), corrupts system authentication files, and embeds itself deeply into the OS. > - **Disables Antivirus:** The malware actively attempts to terminate or kill the process of running AV engines. Once infected, standard antivirus software often fails to detect it. Only specialized, offline bootable rescue environments (such as the 360 System Rescue Disk) can remove it. > > **List of Suspicious Domains:** > 1. `qishui-china.com` (Fake Qishui Music, distributor of Silver Fox via MSI) > 2. `cn-qishui.com` (Fake Qishui Music) > 3. `deepseekk.com.cn` (Fake DeepSeek) > 4. `deepseeka.com.cn` (Fake DeepSeek) > 5. `deepseek-en.com` (Fake DeepSeek International) > 6. `wbtsdiapp-gm.icu` (Fake WhatsApp Log-in Phishing) > > **Suggestion:** > Please review and blacklist these domains immediately to protect all users.
